below: ‘A’, the first-completed version from SDMS, and ‘B’, the reworked version printed in
The Examiner. S. was in Italy when the poem was reprinted in 1819, and either his publisher
Ollier or Peacock was responsible for the changed pointing and other revisions, which have no
authority. Mary S.’s pointing in SDMS has been respected in Text A except where its absence
causes obscurity: commas are added in lines 19, 20, 26, 43, 59, 70, 83, and full stops in lines 36,
48; a colon is added in line 53. Notes that are relevant to both texts will be found under Text B.
